recommendation: Keep the fix. It is the minimal correction needed to align the current active invariant with the published FHIR-13187 decision; any broader R6 dom-3 work should continue under the still-open FHIR-56263 tracker or another final WG decision.
issue_request: FHIR-13187 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core DomainResource. It asked to change dom-3 so a contained resource can satisfy the rule either by being referred to from elsewhere in the containing resource or by referring back to the containing resource, with `#` as the special local reference value and an example showing a contained Provenance targeting its container.
initial_application: Git commit a65f36c6b8ba67bdd1dbf4b68b3636e96bf518c8, matching the Jira comment for svn revision 12864, added the container-reference narrative and Patient/contained Provenance `reference value="#"` example to source/references.html. The DomainResource StructureDefinition was later regenerated/refactored and carried the approved human text plus an intended reverse-reference expression branch.
additional_context: DomainResource is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini [resource-infrastructure], and source/references.html remains active reference guidance. Later same-family decisions support the intended semantics: FHIR-33008 aligned narrative guidance, FHIR-29408/FHIR-31732 addressed local `#` container references in invariants, and FHIR-41692 was retracted after the reporter recognized that the correct container reference is `#`. FHIR-43690 simplified dom-3 for R6 but left the current `reference='#' | as(uri)='#'` branch; submitted FHIR-56263 and its Zulip thread show that FHIRPath precedence parses that subexpression incorrectly, so the branch may not work even though the FHIR-13187 rule is final.
reconciliation: Changed source/domainresource/structuredefinition-DomainResource.xml so the dom-3 container-reference branch uses explicit logical OR: `descendants().where((reference='#') or (as(uri)='#')).exists()`. No narrative edit was needed because source/references.html already states the rule and includes the `#` example.
source_changes: source/domainresource/structuredefinition-DomainResource.xml: changed dom-3 from the precedence-sensitive `reference='#' | as(uri)='#'` test to `(reference='#') or (as(uri)='#')` for contained resources that reference their container.
